items.title: Police charge, warn 2,500 bikers on ‘no-bathing trip’
items.summary: Traffic police have taken legal action against more than 2,500 motorcyclists who took part in this year's “no-bathing trip” in the North, accusing them of repeated violations.

items.title: Elephant runs amok, kills 2 villagers in Surat Thani
items.summary: Two villagers were trampled to death by a domesticated bull elephant in musth that chased residents away from their parked vehicles and overturned a pickup truck outside a house in rural Surat Thani.

items.title: Thailand demanding action on mining waste flowing from Myanmar
items.summary: Thailand has told China and Myanmar that mines operating in Myanmar need to build dykes to hold back the contaminated waste that is polluting rivers flowing across the border into Thailand.

items.title: Surveillance cameras, tyres torched in Narathiwat
items.summary: NARATHIWAT - Insurgents set fire to surveillance cameras and to tyres at five locations in Ra-ngae district early on Sunday, attacks security officials suspect were intended to lure them in an ambush.

items.title: PM reaffirms road-safety goals on Day of Remembrance for crash victims
items.summary: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Sunday reaffirmed the government's commitment to halving road deaths and injuries by 2030, as Thailand marked the annual World Day of Remembrance for Road Traffic Victims (WDR).
